concepts.name: SDGs: Origin, Structure and the 2030 Agenda
key_dimensions: Transition from MDGs to SDGs — what was retained, dropped, and added (e.g., universality, 'Leave No One Behind')
17 Goals, 169 Targets, 232 Indicators — common confusion between targets and indicators in MCQs
Adopted at UN Summit 2015 vs. Paris Agreement 2015 — same year, different forums, frequent mix-up
Non-binding nature of SDGs vs. legally binding Paris Agreement — a classic UPSC trap

concepts.name: India's Voluntary National Review (VNR) Mechanism
key_dimensions: VNR presented at High-Level Political Forum (HLPF) under UN ECOSOC — not UNGA directly
India's VNR submissions: 2017 and 2020 — themes, key highlights and gaps identified
VNR as a self-reporting, non-mandatory tool — no external audit mechanism
Difference between VNR (national) and Voluntary Local Reviews (VLR) by cities/states — India's pioneering states

concepts.name: NITI Aayog as India's Nodal SDG Coordination Agency
key_dimensions: NITI Aayog's role vs. erstwhile Planning Commission — SDGs are 'mapped' not 'planned' centrally
SDG India Index — methodology, weighting, and distinction from VNR
Localisation mandate: NITI coordinates but states/UTs execute — federal dimension
NITI Aayog's SDG coordination vs. Ministry of Statistics (MoSPI) role in indicator monitoring — overlap trap

concepts.name: SDG India Index: Construction, Scoring and Limitations
key_dimensions: Composite score 0–100; categories: Achiever (100), Front Runner (65–99), Performer (50–64), Aspirant (0–49) — exact thresholds tested
Covers all 17 SDGs but uses a subset of national indicators, not all 232 global indicators — a key limitation
State/UT rankings — patterns: who consistently leads (Kerala, Himachal) and who lags (Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam)
Index published by NITI Aayog in partnership with UNDP and MoSPI — multi-agency nature

concepts.name: Mapping of SDGs to Indian Constitutional Provisions
key_dimensions: SDG 16 (Peace, Justice, Strong Institutions) ↔ Articles 14, 21, 39A — rule of law and access to justice
SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities) ↔ DPSPs (Articles 38, 39) — non-justiciable but policy-binding
SDG 5 (Gender Equality) ↔ Articles 15(3), 15(5), 16(2), 39(d) — positive discrimination provisions
Trap: DPSPs align more with SDGs than Fundamental Rights in socio-economic goals — understanding why

concepts.name: SDGs Mapping to Central Government Schemes (Flagship Schemes)
key_dimensions: SDG 1 (No Poverty) ↔ PM-KISAN, PMJDY, MGNREGS — multi-scheme convergence under one goal
SDG 3 (Good Health) ↔ Ayushman Bharat, NHM, PM-JAY — distinguishing scheme components
SDG 4 (Quality Education) ↔ NEP 2020, Samagra Shiksha, PM POSHAN — policy vs. scheme distinction
SDG 7 (Affordable Energy) ↔ UJJWALA, PM-KUSUM, National Solar Mission — energy access vs. clean energy distinction
Trap: One scheme can serve multiple SDGs — e.g., MGNREGS serves SDG 1, 8, 10, 15

concepts.name: SDG Localisation: Role of States and Panchayati Raj Institutions
key_dimensions: Localisation definition — translating global goals into sub-national policies and budgets
Thematic Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) — Shimla, Kochi as early Indian city examples
Panchayat Development Index (PDI) and its linkage to 9 themes mapped to SDGs
Localized SDG plans by states: Sikkim (organic farming → SDG 2), Kerala (social indicators) — state-specific examples

concepts.name: SDG Financing: India's Approach and the Financing Gap
key_dimensions: Estimated financing gap for SDGs in India — UNCTAD and NITI estimates (~$2.5 trillion globally)
Blended Finance concept — combining public, private, and philanthropic capital for SDGs
SDG-aligned budgeting: India's SDG Budget tagging exercise under MoF and NITI Aayog
Distinction: ODA (Official Development Assistance) vs. South-South Cooperation vs. domestic resource mobilization for SDG funding

concepts.name: MoSPI's Role: National Indicator Framework (NIF) for SDGs
key_dimensions: NIF contains 286 national indicators adapted from 232 global indicators — India added more than global framework
Data gaps: many NIF indicators lack baseline data — critical limitation for monitoring
MoSPI vs. NITI Aayog: MoSPI monitors data/indicators; NITI tracks progress and policy coordination — frequent role confusion
Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), NFHS data used as inputs to NIF — data source linkage

concepts.name: SDG 13 (Climate Action) and India's NDC–SDG Nexus
key_dimensions: India's Updated NDC 2022 targets — 45% emissions intensity reduction, 50% non-fossil electricity by 2030
Overlap between SDG 13, SDG 7, and SDG 11 — climate, energy, cities as interconnected goals
India's position: 'common but differentiated responsibilities' under UNFCCC vs. universal SDG commitment — policy tension
LiFE Mission (Lifestyle for Environment) as India's behavioural-change approach to SDG 12 and SDG 13

concepts.name: SDG 5 (Gender Equality): India's Performance and Policy Response
key_dimensions: India's rank on Global Gender Gap Index vs. SDG India Index score for SDG 5 — different methodologies, different results
Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, PM Matru Vandana Yojana, POSHAN Abhiyaan — scheme mapping to specific SDG 5 targets
Women's political representation: 33% reservation (106th CAA, 2023) as SDG 5 milestone — recent development
Trap: SDG 5 is standalone but gender is also a 'cross-cutting' theme in SDGs 1, 3, 4, 8, 10, 16

concepts.name: SDG 16 (Peace, Justice, Strong Institutions): India's Governance Mapping
key_dimensions: Specific targets: reduce violence, end abuse/exploitation, promote rule of law, reduce illicit flows, develop accountable institutions
RTI Act, e-Courts, PRAGATI platform, DBT as governance-strengthening measures under SDG 16
India's stand: SDG 16 was controversial during SDG negotiations — some developing nations opposed it as Western imposition
Corruption Perception Index (Transparency International) as a proxy indicator — India's rank trends and limitations of using such indices

concepts.name: SDG 17 (Partnerships for Goals): India as Both Recipient and Provider
key_dimensions: Technology transfer, capacity building, trade, and finance as the four pillars of SDG 17
India's South-South Cooperation: ITEC programme, development assistance to neighbours — India as provider
India's demand for reformed multilateralism under SDG 17 — WTO, IMF quota reform linkage
Addis Ababa Action Agenda (AAAA) 2015 as the financing framework for SDG 17 — often confused with SDG document itself

concepts.name: SDG Progress Tracking: Global vs. India-Specific Assessments
key_dimensions: UN's Sustainable Development Goals Report (annual) vs. NITI Aayog's SDG India Index — different scopes
2023 SDG Summit ('midpoint review') findings: only ~15% of SDGs on track globally — India's relative position
India's areas of strong performance: SDG 7 (energy access), SDG 9 (infrastructure) vs. laggard areas: SDG 2 (hunger), SDG 3 (health outcomes in states)
Trap: Good SDG India Index score ≠ good global SDG ranking — domestic vs. international benchmarking difference

concepts.name: SDG 2 (Zero Hunger) and India: The Food-Nutrition-Agriculture Nexus
key_dimensions: India's paradox: food surplus (FCI buffer stocks) yet high malnutrition (NFHS-5 data on stunting, wasting) — production vs. access gap
Global Hunger Index (GHI) controversy — India's objections to GHI methodology vs. NFHS data acknowledgment
PM POSHAN (mid-day meal), POSHAN Abhiyaan, National Food Security Act — scheme convergence for SDG 2
SDG 2 target 2.4: sustainable food production systems — linkage to agroecology, PM-KISAN, and soil health cards

concepts.name: SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities): AMRUT, Smart Cities and Urban SDG Mapping
key_dimensions: AMRUT 2.0 vs. Smart Cities Mission — different objectives, both mapped to SDG 11 but distinct target coverage
SDG 11.1: adequate housing → PM Awas Yojana (Urban); SDG 11.6: air quality → NCAP — target-level scheme mapping
Urban Local Bodies' (ULBs) fiscal capacity as a structural barrier to SDG 11 achievement
Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) by Indian cities as SDG 11-specific localisation tools

concepts.name: India's SDG Performance on Health (SDG 3): Gaps and Interventions
key_dimensions: Key SDG 3 targets: end AIDS/TB/malaria, reduce maternal mortality (MMR), reduce under-5 mortality, UHC coverage
India's MMR decline (254 in 2004 → 97 in 2018–20) — progress but still above SDG target of <70 per lakh live births
National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP): India's 2025 target vs. global 2030 SDG target — India more ambitious
Ayushman Bharat – PM-JAY as Universal Health Coverage (UHC) instrument — coverage vs. quality gap trap

concepts.name: SDG 10 (Reduced Inequalities): India's Inter-State and Intra-State Divergence
key_dimensions: Gini coefficient trends in India — income inequality vs. consumption inequality measurement differences
Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP) as a targeted convergence model for SDG 10 — left-behind geography focus
SDG 10.7: migration and mobility — India's internal migration policy gap vs. SDG commitment
Finance Commission (horizontal devolution) and GST compensation as fiscal federalism tools for reducing inter-state inequality under SDG 10

concepts.name: SDG 15 (Life on Land): Biodiversity, Forest Cover and India's Mapping
key_dimensions: India's forest cover increase (FSI data) vs. quality degradation — area vs. ecosystem health distinction
SDG 15 ↔ Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (30x30 target) — post-2020 biodiversity linkage
Green India Mission (GIM) under NAPCC as SDG 15 instrument — not to be confused with afforestation under CAMPA
Compensatory Afforestation Fund (CAMPA) and its SDG 15 relevance — recent SC directions on fund utilisation

concepts.name: MDGs vs. SDGs: Structural Differences and India's Transition
key_dimensions: MDGs: 8 goals, developing countries only, top-down, ODA-driven vs. SDGs: 17 goals, universal, inclusive, multi-stakeholder
India's MDG performance: achieved MDG 1 (poverty) and MDG 4 (child mortality) partially — lessons for SDG design
Shift from 'development assistance' model (MDGs) to 'development partnership' model (SDGs) — India's preferred framing
Trap: MDGs had no official indicator framework at adoption; SDGs had 230+ indicators from the start — process difference
